brain-poll.title: a positive whole number
brain-poll.description: The interval in milliseconds between brain readiness and shutdown checks.

brain-start-timeout.title: a positive whole number
brain-start-timeout.description: The maximum time in milliseconds to start or reuse a ready local brain.

brain-stop-timeout.title: a positive whole number
brain-stop-timeout.description: The maximum time in milliseconds to confirm the local brain and its children have stopped.

brain-throttle.title: a positive whole number
brain-throttle.description: The delay in whole seconds between crash restarts of the local brain.

port.title: a port
port.description: The port the local instance listens on.
